verdict.rationale: Helicone exposes request logs through a REST query endpoint (/v1/request/query), HQL querying, webhooks to external systems, and a one-line PostHog export. A developer could build their own pipeline into storage on top of these, but there is no evidence of a native bulk export to blob storage or a data warehouse. missing for 10: native bulk export to S3/GCS/blob storage, data-warehouse connectors (e.g., Snowflake/BigQuery), dataset export, documented scheduled or bulk export jobs, hands-on corroboration.
